sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Signworld America offers signage products and trade show displays with over 50 years of experience, providing in-house printing and same-day shipping from their headquarters in Rancho Cucamonga, California.

Industry: Retail Trade · HQ: Rancho Cucamonga, CA · Size: not published · Products: Trade Show Display Sets, LED Backlit Lightbox Displays, Pop Up Displays, Banner Stands, Advertising Flags, Custom Prints

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Display-Wholesale.com scores 29 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30). Nothing was found for company size and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (22% similar on display, print, media, sign); Mactac (10% similar on print, printing, signage, sign). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
